messages:
arushi: Quick sync — planned v2 switch tomorrow 10:00 PT. Staging showed ~0.6% client errors from header case-sensitivity for an old mobile SDK. Can we: (1) add a header-normalize shim in gateway for this slice, or (2) greenlist those tenants to v1? Deploy window is small; prefer minimal blast radius. Thoughts? :thinking:

leo: I saw the same. Root cause: some SDKs send `version` vs `Version`. Gateway currently does strict match. I lean gateway shim with toggle per-tenant.

sam: Shim + greenlist fallback. If shim has perf impact, we fallback tenant->v1. Need rollback criteria defined.

mike: Agree. Perf wise the shim is just lowercasing one header — negligible. But adding per-tenant routing increases config churn.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window created by @arushi for 2024-10-23 17:00 UTC. Runbook: /runbooks/v2-toggle.ops

arushi: Plan: implement shim behind feature flag, enable for a small greenlist of 5 tenants for initial warmup (traffic slice ~3%). Monitor 5xx + client schema errors for 30m. If 5xx > 0.5% or client schema errors spike x5, rollback to v1 for affected tenants.

leo: Where do we record the greenlist? I'll push config to ops-config repo and tag `v2-header-shim-greenlist`.

sam: Add release-notes section: 'temporary header-normalization enabled for legacy SDKs — known to change header casing behavior; contact support if you rely on exact-case headers.'

mike: Also add metric: `gateway.header_normalize.hit_rate` and `routing.v1_fallback.count` to dashboard.

arushi: I'll do the PRs. @deploy-bot, please hold the rollout until I post PR links and the deploy checklist is green.

deploy-bot: Hold applied. Awaiting manual release trigger.

sam: I'll watch metrics during warmup.

leo: PR created: https://git.internal/ops-config/commit/abc123 — greenlist entries for tenants A,B,C,D,E.

arushi: PR #456 in gateway to add feature flag: https://git.internal/gateway/pull/456 — ready for review.

mike: Reviewed, lgtm. Quick test pass in staging.

arushi: OK, scheduling warmup for 15:00 PT (1 hour warmup). Manual trigger only. Rolling to greenlist, then observe 30m. If stable, expand to 25%.

sam: noted. I'll be online for monitoring. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Manual release triggered by @arushi at 1747220400. Rolling to greenlist.

sam: First 10m: gateway.header_normalize.hit_rate ~2.8%, no 5xx, client-schema errors steady.

leo: 25m: still stable. expand to 25% per plan.

deploy-bot: Scaling rollout to 25% at 1747220600.

mike: Monitoring looks clean. No rollback criteria met. Recommend expand to full fleet after 2 hours or tomorrow morning low-traffic window.

arushi: We'll hold expansion overnight. Update release notes and send customer comms for the five tenants. Thanks team.

sam: Filed release notes PR: https://git.internal/docs/release-notes/PR789

arushi: Closing thread; followups in docs. :white_check_mark:
